verdict.rationale: Lovable documents a Settings → Plans & credit usage page for checking credit balance, tracking credit usage, adding credits, and managing top-ups, and it confirms a free plan exists by default. The evidence does not show how many credits individual actions consume or what each plan includes, so only part of the story is covered. Missing for 10: per-action credit consumption details, plan-by-plan inclusion breakdown, independent or hands-on corroboration of usage transparency.
